bayts.text: Bless with a blessing that leads truthfulness to me in my services and rains down effusions in them like rain,
with a peace that bestows fidelity on me in them, upon the effacer who effaced what terrifies.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And guard all my sides from turbidity, O You by Whose command the decree flows.
And grant me clarity in the nights and in all the days, with my family.
And turn what draws misery and hardship toward other than my person, and protect me from every toil.
And make the world lead the benefits to me, (I) a slave, a righteous servant.
And drive toward others than me all corruptions, (I) a grateful slave, and protect me from what is corrupt.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
To You be my gratitude forever and my praise, O You Who preserve me from error and intent.
Bless with a blessing that illumines all of me and mends the body, O Fashioner (Al-Muṣawwir),
with a peace that takes away sickness toward other than my person, together with the enemies,
upon the beautified, the beautiful man, the good, the best, the giver of glad tidings.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me interpretation and exegesis, and make both easy for me, an easing.
And preserve my creeds together with the words, all the deeds and the states.
And lead the characters to noble traits, and protect me from straying and destitution.
And in the Book and the ḥadīth grant me what the righteous did not attain before me.
And break the customs for me in the disciplines, O Giver of the manifest and the hidden.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
Bless with a blessing that makes the beneficial sciences sound for me through You: for You are the All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm).
with a peace that makes sound for me the righteous deed that completes hope,
upon him for whom I have led my ink, with pens that my love has led,
for Your noble Countenance, O Lord, for years, (I) a slave, a servant; and You spared me moaning.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
You have led my creeds with my words and my deeds toward good, like the states.
You have made the characters dwell in noble traits, O You Who effaced exile and destitution.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You honoured me by Your being the Generous, and led help and honour to me.
Bless with a blessing no blessing can match, that removes the haters toward a direction other than mine,
with a peace that makes the difficult easy for me, upon him through whom the journey has ended at You.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make through him my soul with my desire two helpers for me, through You, toward my God-fearing.
And lead both with the best of good to the Gardens, and preserve all of me and illumine the heart for me.
And preserve the heart from others (than You), and make my life the glad tidings of the elect.
And busy Your enemies with other than harming me, O Everlasting Who made my joy abide.
Bear witness for me to my gratitude to You in the solitary (month), Rajab, and in others, O You Who perpetuate wonder for me.
My word about You today: I cannot enumerate the praise of an Everlasting One Who has been for me, O Reckoner (Al-Muḥṣī).
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
Bless with a blessing that takes the enemies away toward other than what You chose for me, and they go,
with a peace that acknowledges my success, without misery, drawing from effusions,
upon him through whom You have put me forward forever, through You, without meeting toil.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And drive through him the hateful things of the two Abodes toward other than my person, together with the two disgraces.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
Bless with a blessing that draws the best of good for me forever, that milks the milk of knowledge,
for me, with a lasting peace that subdues for me every enemy and makes all of me skilful,
upon him through whom Your being for me has appeared, and his being for me, through You, has also become renowned.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And write for me today and after today my being a joy for the best of the people,
without meeting an unbeliever, or a hypocrite, or an associator; and make my market thriving.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
Bless with a blessing whose light endures, that bears witness for me that I am the servant,
with a peace whose benefit does not end, that leads to me with good pleasure what I desire,
upon the Hāshimite, Arab Prophet, him through whom You fulfilled, Lord, my need.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And lead to me the greatest in all my aims, O You Who efface my illnesses.
And grant me in writing and recitation above the rewards of the radiant ones, and sweetness.
And make my life glad tidings for the Chosen, in his Family and his Companions possessed of God-fearing.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
